law_record.title: Bus parking, loading and unloading (A)(5)
law_record.text: The operator of a bus, other than a tour bus, shall: Not stand or park a bus at a bus stop or an origin or destination point for a period of time longer than has been designated for such bus stop or origin or destination point in accordance with Section 11.60.010 [DEF-LVMC-11-60-010].

activation_conditions: the subject operates a bus other than a tour bus
it stands or parks at a bus stop or origin or destination point longer than the period designated for that place
residue: the designated period comes from the administrative designation the cited provision carries; without a posted time the rule reports unknown
summary.subject: bus_operator

timing_requirements.requirement: the limit is whatever the designation for that stop says — the rule has no number of its own, so the period must be read from the sign or declared
the trace must cover the whole dwell for the limit to be checkable
